newsitem.title: USA: Cincinnati Bell votes two-for-one split.
newsitem.headline: Cincinnati Bell votes two-for-one split.

text.p: Cincinnati Bell Inc said Monday its board of directors approved a two-for-one split of its common shares, payable to shareholders of record as of May 2.
The split will double the number of Cincinnati Bell common shares outstanding. There were 67.6 million shares outstanding as of December 31.
Following the split, the annual cash divided rate will be $0.40 a share, compared with the previous annual rate on a pre-split basis of $0.80.
"This action signifies the board's confidence in management and our desire to promote a broader shareholder base," Cincinnati Bell Chairman Charles Mechem said in a statement.
